about_short_description.short_description: Columnar is a SaaS company that offers fast universal data connectivity services.

product.name: ADBC Connectivity Platform
product.description: Arrow-native database connectivity based on the ADBC standard, enabling applications to query and exchange data with databases in columnar format across multiple languages.

product.name: dbc
product.description: A command-line tool for installing, discovering, and managing ADBC drivers across Linux, macOS, and Windows.

product.name: databow
product.description: A command-line tool for querying databases through ADBC drivers from a terminal.

product.name: DuckDB ADBC Extension
product.description: A DuckDB extension that connects DuckDB to databases supported by ADBC for querying, attaching, inserting, copying, and table creation.

product.name: ADBC Driver Foundry
product.description: An open-source hub for developing, publishing, and maintaining ADBC drivers for database and query systems.
